tells: 1. Face close is broken by CG geometry: the blonde woman behind has a stretched, faceted neck and flat-shaded polygon collar, and the green-top figure behind the lead is an untextured smeared low-poly slab (club-4-face.png, left third and centre-left behind the lead)

2. The laugh barely happens: across 1.0 s only the white-sweater woman lifts a hand; every other front-row face and body is nearly unchanged, so nothing reads as caused by a line (club-5-strip.png, all frames, front row)

3. The wide and held frames show near-identical poses and head angles for the whole front row, so at living-room distance the room reads as a held still (club-1-wide.png vs club-6-held.png, front two rows)

4. Bodies are lit like game assets: the lead's skin in the close is overexposed and waxy with glossy CG eyes and plastic hair shells, and the clothing shading is flat with no contact shadow on the tables (club-4-face.png, centre face; club-1-wide.png, tables)

5. The back of the house is a cut-out band of identical dark silhouettes in a regular grid, with front-row people standing behind tables at head heights that don't match seated bodies (club-1-wide.png and club-2-mid.png, rows 3+ and the bar wall)

1. Seating doesn't hold the bodies: the second row's heads and full torsos rise above the seat backs as if standing, and the front row's legs hang in front of the seats instead of folding into them (theatre-1-wide.png, rows 1-2 centre; theatre-3-mid.png, front row)

2. Severe low-poly LOD in the face close: the brown-jacket figure behind left is a faceted slab with a flat sliver hand, the green-shirt figure behind right has a smeared texture, and the hoop earring clips into the jacket collar (theatre-4-face.png, left third, right third and centre earring)

3. The back of the house is flat cardboard silhouettes with the same profile repeated in rows, glowing blue specks sitting among them, and no depth falloff between them and the lit rows (theatre-1-wide.png and theatre-2-mid.png, top half)

4. Duplicate characters are visible in one frame: two short-blonde women in grey and two curly-haired men in green shirts sit within a seat or two of each other, plus the same purple-top woman from the club (theatre-1-wide.png, rows 1-2)

5. The left group in the mid shot is desaturated and ghostly, with a red-jacket figure smeared as if motion-blurred or under-sampled, so it doesn't sit in the same light as the centre (theatre-3-mid.png, left quarter)

1. Face close: the lead's hair is a hard-edged textured card that shows its brushed-plane pattern behind the ear, and the blonde woman behind right has a detached, glove-like hand floating in front of her jacket (openmic-4-face.png, centre-right hair and right edge at about 1150,580)

2. The front rows are packed so tight that shoulders and arms interpenetrate, and the second row's heads stack directly on the front row's shoulders, which reads as a pile of characters rather than people in chairs (openmic-1-wide.png, centre front; openmic-3-mid.png, centre)
3. A visible seam line runs down the centre of the afro man's hair, and the hairline has a hard alpha edge (openmic-2-mid.png, about 300,240)

4. The skin is waxy and evenly front-lit with the same peach sheen on every face; eyes are glassy with no wet catchlight variation, so faces read as game NPCs at 2-3 m (openmic-2-mid.png, front row faces; openmic-4-face.png)

5. The room is a bare box: a flat beige door panel with no detail, a single green exit sign and evenly spaced lamp glows give a CG stage-set look behind the crowd (openmic-1-wide.png, left wall door and back wall)
